workspace.name: Player_Elite_Escort
workspace.author: EliteModder
workspace.description: Automatically equips the user playership with heavy wing escorts on game entry.

propertiesSchema.label: Instantiate
propertiesSchema.description: Creates a dynamic copy of this cue each time context occurs

propertiesSchema.label: Delay (exact)
propertiesSchema.description: Wait this long between trigger and actions. X4 time, e.g. 5s, 1min. Use this OR min+max.

propertiesSchema.label: Delay (min)
propertiesSchema.description: Random delay lower bound (pairs with Delay max).

propertiesSchema.label: Delay (max)
propertiesSchema.description: Random delay upper bound (pairs with Delay min).

propertiesSchema.label: Is Library
propertiesSchema.description: Emit as <library> (a reusable subroutine called by signal_cue) instead of <cue>.

propertiesSchema.label: Library Params (raw XML)
propertiesSchema.description: Only used when Is Library = true. The <params> block, kept verbatim.

propertiesSchema.label: Signaling Cue
propertiesSchema.description: Triggered when this standard system startup cue completes

propertiesSchema.label: Ship Class Macro
propertiesSchema.placeholder: Search ship macros… or type a variable
propertiesSchema.description: Searchable against the real installed game index (ships + DLC).

propertiesSchema.label: Owner Faction
propertiesSchema.description: All factions from the installed game + DLC. Stored as the short code (e.g. argon); the compiler emits faction.argon.
